result.summary: This signalized intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians to navigate wide expanses of roadway without dedicated protection. The presence of curb ramps suggests intended pedestrian use, but the overall design prioritizes vehicular movement over safety.

hazards.name: Absence of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks pedestrian-specific signal heads, making it difficult for pedestrians to know when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and worn, creating potential trip hazards and affecting vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time remaining.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection at Fox St provides basic sidewalk infrastructure and a curb ramp but lacks essential pedestrian safety features like marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The roadway surface is significantly degraded with faded or missing lane markings, creating a hostile environment for people crossing the street.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps, but is dominated by a wide, multi-lane roadway designed for high vehicle throughput. Pedestrian safety is compromised by faded crosswalk markings and a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signals at a major commercial crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground across the side street approach

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration of the main road creates a long, unprotected exposure time for pedestrians crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway crossing from the right corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.
